# ADR-NNNN: <Decision as a short imperative phrase>

- Status: Proposed | Accepted | Superseded by NNNN
- Date: YYYY-MM-DD
- Deciders: <names>

## Context

What problem or force makes a decision necessary? What constraints apply (team, cost, time, security,
stakeholders)? Keep it factual. 5–10 lines.

## Decision

What we will do, concretely enough that someone could check the code against it.

## Consequences

- Positive: …
- Negative / accepted risks: …
- Follow-up work: …

## Alternatives considered

- **Option** — why not (one or two lines each).

## Revisit when

A concrete trigger (an event, a metric or a date), not "later".
